# Scroll panel (`scroll-panel`)

Fixed-height scrolling region with themed scrollbar.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createList` (types in `dist/web/data-display/list.d.ts`): `ul.mh-list`: rows with a leading icon or avatar, title, subtitle and trailing slot. `--dividers`, `--inset`.

```ts
export function createList(options: ListOptions): ListHandle;

export interface ListOptions {
  items: ListItemOptions[];
  /** Rules between rows (default true). */
  dividers?: boolean;
  /** Rows in a rounded surface, settings style. */
  inset?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the list. */
  label?: string;
}

export interface ListHandle {
  el: HTMLUListElement;
  setItems(items: ListItemOptions[]): void;
}

export interface ListItemOptions {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A leading icon in a soft square. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** A leading element instead of the icon (an avatar). */
  leading?: HTMLElement;
  /** Trailing content: a value ("On", "21°") or an element (a badge, a switch on a non-pressable row). */
  trailing?: Child;
  /** Shows a chevron: the row opens something. */
  chevron?: boolean;
  /** Makes the row a button. Don't combine with an interactive `trailing` control. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  /** Makes the row a link. */
  href?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Marks the current row (`aria-current`). */
  current?: boolean;
  tone?: 'default' | 'danger';
}
```

`createScrollPanel` (types in `dist/web/layout/scrollPanel.d.ts`): `.mh-scroll-panel` (`--sm | --lg | --fill`, `--x`, `--plain`, `--inset`; `.is-overflow-start`, `.is-overflow-end`): a fixed-height region whose `__viewport` scrolls with a themed scrollbar and fades its edges while there is more to see.

```ts
export function createScrollPanel(options: ScrollPanelOptions, ...children: Child[]): ScrollPanelHandle;

export interface ScrollPanelOptions {
  /** Default `medium`; `fill` takes the height of its container. */
  size?: ScrollPanelSize;
  /** Scroll direction (default `y`). */
  axis?: 'x' | 'y';
  /** Accessible name; the viewport is a focusable region so keyboards can scroll it. */
  label: string;
  /** Edge shadows hint at more content (default true). */
  shadows?: boolean;
  /** An inset well instead of a bare region. */
  inset?: boolean;
}

export interface ScrollPanelHandle extends ScrollPanelController {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** The scrolling element; append content here. */
  viewport: HTMLDivElement;
  scrollToStart(): void;
  scrollToEnd(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createList, createScrollPanel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Hall', 'Bedroom', 'Office', 'Bathroom', 'Garden', 'Garage', 'Attic'];

const list = createList({
  items: rooms.map((title, i) => ({ title, subtitle: `${i + 1} devices`, icon: 'home' })),
});

const panel = createScrollPanel({ label: 'Rooms', size: 'medium' }, list.el);

document.body.append(panel.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { List, ListItem, ScrollPanel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const ROOMS = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Hall', 'Bedroom', 'Office', 'Bathroom', 'Garden', 'Garage', 'Attic'];

export function ScrollPanelExample() {
  return (
    <ScrollPanel label="Rooms" size="medium">
      <List>
        {ROOMS.map((room, i) => (
          <ListItem key={room} title={room} subtitle={`${i + 1} devices`} icon="home" />
        ))}
      </List>
    </ScrollPanel>
  );
}
```
